boundaryGate.question: After accepted Alembic commit 01e70642260e61fca2174a87106b22ad21b6ad81 releases cancelled ProjectContext workflow sessions, can the real BiliDili no-preclean P10 host route retry without stale active-session blockage and reach a valid non-empty host/in-process parity result?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: Real BiliDili workspace and its Alembic data root for the P10 project-index workflow-unify route only. This card verifies Test evidence after the Alembic session-cancellation repair; it does not authorize source edits, provider changes, manual DB/session row edits, non-BiliDili ~/.asd cleanup, or final acceptance of P10/G4/G6.
controllerSelfChecks: Controller accepted Alembic commit 01e70642260e61fca2174a87106b22ad21b6ad81 as a narrow cancellation/session lease cleanup repair.
Controller reran `npm test -- --run test/unit/ProjectContextWorkflowFacts.test.ts` in Alembic and it passed 14 tests.
Controller reran `npm run build:check` in Alembic and it passed.
Prior Test blocker showed the daemon job cancellation path cancelled the job but left the ProjectContext workflow active session incomplete, blocking retry.
realScenarioConditions: Use the real BiliDili workspace directly; do not create a sandbox copy.
Preserve configured providers: DeepSeek for generation and local Qwen/Ollama for embeddings.
Prefer the already-running BiliDili daemon only if the Test environment verifier reports ready and points to the BiliDili data root.
If daemon restart is required, use the documented BiliDili no-preclean route and prove preclean is skipped.
Before any rebuild/destructive operation, prove the R-2 root/dataRoot route so cleanup cannot touch a non-BiliDili root.
Do not manually edit or delete active session files, DB rows, coverage ledgers, WAL/SHM files, source files, package versions, provider config, or unrelated ~/.asd data.
successMeans: The repaired host route is not blocked by the stale active ProjectContext workflow session from the prior cancellation.
If a bounded cancellation is used, cancellation releases or replaces the workflow lease so a retry can start without manual cleanup.
Host route reaches usable completion with `coverageLedgerSeed` metadata and non-empty target-scoped coverage.
In-process route produces non-empty target-scoped coverage for the same normalized scope.
Normalized host-vs-in-process parity diff is empty, excluding only documented volatile runtime fields.
No stale active sessions or open rounds remain after completion/cleanup.
failureMeans: Stale ProjectContext active session or open round still blocks retry after cancellation/completion.
The no-preclean route would touch a non-BiliDili root or cannot prove R-2 projectRoot/dataRoot safety.
Daemon/MCP/provider/environment setup prevents a valid real BiliDili route and no safe controller-authorized workaround exists.
Host coverage remains empty, aggregate/root-scoped only, lacks `coverageLedgerSeed`, or parity is 0-vs-0.
Host vs in-process normalized diff remains non-empty.
DB corruption, rebuild/reset failure, or fullReset fail-closed diagnostics prevent parity from running.
cannotConclude: Cannot conclude P10/G4/G6/final demand completion from session cleanup alone.
Cannot conclude source correctness from a successful job cancellation without retry evidence.
Cannot conclude parity from empty ledgers, aggregate/root module ids, or 0-vs-0 comparison.
Cannot conclude Test may repair source/provider/MCP/DB/session state; such blockers return to controller with evidence.
Cannot conclude non-BiliDili roots are safe without explicit R-2 proof.
stopConditions: R-2 root/dataRoot proof fails or points outside real BiliDili boundaries.
Any needed operation would clean or mutate unrelated ~/.asd roots.
The route requires manual DB/session/coverage edits to proceed.
Provider config is missing or mismatched and cannot be verified as DeepSeek generation plus local Qwen embedding.
Alembic MCP transport repair/reload would be required from Test.
A bounded cancellation leaves a stale session and retry remains blocked after the accepted Alembic repair.

evidenceRequired: Environment and source-pin JSON, including Alembic commit 01e70642260e61fca2174a87106b22ad21b6ad81 or a clearly justified newer accepted pin from this state root.
R-2 projectRoot/dataRoot proof before any destructive/reset operation.
Daemon health/test-mode and no-preclean proof if restart is needed.
DB schema and `PRAGMA integrity_check` evidence before the run and after any rebuild/reset.
Active ProjectContext workflow session and open deep-mining round snapshots before host, after cancellation/completion, and after retry/completion.
Host route output proving `coverageLedgerSeed` metadata when the route reaches usable completion.
Non-empty target-scoped host coverage ledger/cell evidence, with aggregate/root module ids excluded.
Non-empty target-scoped in-process coverage ledger/cell evidence, with moduleScope behavior recorded.
Normalized host-vs-in-process parity artifact; success requires diff == empty and not 0-vs-0.
allowedOperations: Read Test AGENTS, state root, this test card, prior Test blocker evidence, and the Alembic controller review.

Record source pins, provider config, daemon health, DB/schema/integrity, active-session/open-round snapshots, command lines, runtime JSON, logs, and parity artifacts under the Test tmp directory for this task.
Run the official real BiliDili no-preclean host route after the Alembic repair.
If the host route times out or is cancelled by the bounded test, capture cancellation/job/session cleanup evidence and then verify whether a subsequent retry is unblocked.
Run the in-process/moduleScope parity route only after the host route has produced usable non-empty target-scoped coverage evidence.
forbiddenOperations: Do not repair or reload the Alembic MCP surface from Test if it reports Transport closed; use the Dashboard/daemon route or block with evidence.
Do not use default preclean, do not clean logs or data outside the BiliDili data root, and do not touch unrelated ~/.asd roots.
Do not manually fix DB/session/coverage rows to make parity pass.
Do not accept 0-vs-0 parity or aggregate/root module coverage as success.
Do not edit Alembic, AlembicPlugin, AlembicCore, BiliDili source, provider config, versions, release assets, frozen names, or dispatch onward.
